evidence_scope: CPU tests + source inspection; NO NVIDIA CUDA execution

findings.finding: rx_lock cleared before delivery, causing old sender lookup -1
findings.decision: Pass tx_node explicitly; CPU static regression; CUDA real packet required

findings.finding: GPU default rx_lock_on_cca=True disagrees with CPU SNR decode
findings.decision: Set False by default, preserve optional sensitivity experiment

findings.finding: Repeated SEND to same destination overwrites previous pending_seq/words
findings.decision: Keep one outstanding request/destination until ACK or expiry; trace on CUDA required

findings.finding: Kernel sets overflow then advances now, host previously ignored flag
findings.decision: Raise RuntimeError on overflow and reject stale transitions

findings.finding: reset_v67.py used np.asarray without importing numpy
findings.decision: Add missing import; CUDA compilation still unverified

findings.finding: Reset retained old ledger_pos, counters and pending payload arrays
findings.decision: Clear all SoA arrays then initialize canonical sentinels

findings.finding: GPU input casts allowed silent invalid shapes/NaN/out-of-bounds cell IDs
findings.decision: Validate sensing/action/PHY values before GPU upload

findings.finding: Parameterized 30-UAV/40x40 requests can exceed 195GiB network-only @2048 env
findings.decision: Block over-budget allocations; verify free VRAM device-wide

findings.finding: Cross-version v66/v67 comparisons mix termination; 1 vs2km change UAV density
findings.decision: Compare effective config, inventory densities, matched peer/no-peer pairs

findings.finding: No named matched 3km stress profiles although grid60 supported
findings.decision: Two config profiles added at 135 targets, 6 UAV; no convergence claims

findings.finding: WarpCompressedRadioNetworkV67 is not used in actor->rollout->reward->replay->gradient->eval
findings.decision: Integrate whole environment and learner, test 32 then256 then2048/4096 env

findings.finding: NumPySoARefV67 uses ideal single-hop delivery; no CCA/collision/backoff/ACK parity
findings.decision: Build timestamped trace comparison against CPU 7-radio and upstream UavNetSim

findings.finding: Warp queue cap32 vs CPU configurable max200, learned per-radio TX absent
findings.decision: Align or label performance ablation as custom protocol; measure PDR/delay/queues

findings.finding: r_gcs_aoi is freshness-at-first-confirmation, not continuous AoI penalty
findings.decision: Preregister separate continuous-AoI ablation with equivalent scales

findings.finding: Main profiles use mf=me=.80 fixed and confirm=.90; false alarms need calibration
findings.decision: Compare 0.90 vs0.99 and likelihood-ratio BBAs by precision/recall

findings.finding: Actor XY at fixed 50m; obstacles affect 3D LOS, not full 3D flight policy
findings.decision: Define as planar search at fixed altitude; validate swept collisions and battery before conclusions

findings.finding: gen-only watermark loses same-timestamp count changes; equivalence requires strict 1 observation/cell/time
findings.decision: Enforce measurement generation version or narrow scope of claim and test duplicate timestamps

findings.finding: Single TX scalar, network-only mode; no mobility midpoint or per-UAV flight+TX energy
findings.decision: Port full physics, network substeps and energy/reward on GPU with parity tests

findings.finding: PDR packet denominator differs from discovery/coverage and does not prove target correctness
findings.decision: Plot distinct PDR/latency/accuracy/coverage/energy versus environment steps

findings.finding: Venue Q1/A* not a theorem about this code; publications use different objective/methods
findings.decision: Label Zhang/Xue/UavNetSim as inspirations; report ablations and reproducible environment
